content: Royal Activities: Live BBQ Nights, The Tipping Bucket (Giant Water Splash), Kids Adventure Park, Twisting Pool Slides, Rain Dance Arena with Music, Mushroom Fountain, Indoor Games (Carrom, TT), and large Outdoor Sports area for Cricket.
Humare paas bhot saari activities hain jisme Tipping Bucket, Rain dance (music ke saath), Pool slides, aur Indoor/Outdoor khel shamil hain. Aap BBQ (barbeque) ka bhi mazza le sakte hain!

Amenities: Private Pool Access, High-Speed WiFi, Caretaker On-Call, Fully Air-Conditioned Bedrooms, Smart TV with OTT, Fully Equipped Kitchen (Microwave, Refrigerator, Water Purifier), 24/7 Hot Water, Inverter Power Backup, Extra mattresses, and Pet Friendly (On Request).
Yaha par aapko pura 4BHK villa milega AC ke sath. Sath me Private pool, caretaker, puri equipped kitchen, fridge, microwave, wifi aur tv hoga. Inverter backup bhi available hai.
Our Location: Near Coral School, Padgha - 421101. 32 Kms from Thane. Call Us +91 9890205767. Available 24/7.
Hamara villa Padgha me hai (Coral School ke paas). Thane se 32 kilometer door hai. Aap hume +91 9890205767 par call ya whatsapp kar sakte hain.

Pricing: Weekday Escape (Mon-Fri) for ₹18,000 / night for up to 20 Guests. Royal Weekend (Sat-Sun) for ₹20,000 / night for up to 20 Guests. Includes Full 4BHK Villa Access, Private Pool & Lounge, Music System Allowed. No Hidden costs.
Agar aap Somvaar se Shukravaar (Weekday) aate hain to charge ₹18,000 per night hai. Agar Shanivaar - Ravivaar (Weekend) aate hain to ₹20,000 per night hai. Maximum 20 log allow hain isi price mein.
Experience the height of luxury living. Where every moment is crafted for your absolute comfort. Indulge in a retreat that redefines the art of relaxation with 5,000 sq.ft of private luxury.
Yaha aapko 100% privacy milti hai. 5,000 sq ft ki jagah aapse koi share nahi karega. Aap apne parivar ke sath aaram se relax kar sakte hain.
